newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends scarcely changed.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends scarcely changed.

text.p: London white sugar futures ended hardly changed after trading in tight ranges through Wednesday. December last traded down $0.20 at $303.60 and March was up $0.20 at $303.50 after a day when traders tidied up spot positions before the December expiry.
Traders said the Dec/March spread would probably finish at even money by the end of the week.
Market sources said Polish white sugar was likely to feature in the physical deliveries against the December expiry as freight orders had already been issued for Polish ports.
Elsewhere, a total 103,150 tonnes of current series white sugar received export rebates of a maximum 47.098 European Currency Units (Ecus) per 100 kilos at this week's EU tender.
